verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents its own rate limiting to prevent expensive bills, and Dynamic Routing flows that enforce quotas and restrict each user, project or team with budget or rate limits. Those guardrails could be scoped to an agent treated as a user or project. However, nothing documents issuing a dedicated per-agent key that carries those limits, and the budget mechanics are thinly described. Missing for 10: documented per-agent/scoped API key issuance, detail on how budget caps are configured and enforced, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give an autonomous agent its own key with budget and rate guardrails so it cannot run away on spend

citations.quote: Rate limiting controls the traffic that reaches your application, which prevents expensive bills and suspicious activity.
you can limit your application to 100 requests per 60 seconds.
Restricting each user/project/team with budget/rate limits
you compose a small flow that evaluates conditions, enforces quotas, and chooses models with fallbacks.
